name: Itsudemo Seikou!? Idol Gakuen!
original_name: いつでも性交！？ アイドル学園！
source:
Boys weren't allowed into the legendary school of allegedly all idols.
To see if it even existed, Kou Tennomiya went to that place and saw a string of beauties entering the fortress-like outer gate.
Including his own stepsister.

"The rumor was true......"

When Kou attempted to chat with some girls passing by they looked at him like a piece of garbage, and guardmen jerked him aside and laid him out.
The girls went on merrily as if nothing happened.

"Hrumph."
Strewn like a dirty cloth, a sparkle flitted in Kou's eye.

He went home and consulted his father.

The next day Kou went to the same place, only the guards
from yesterday were now lined up and bowing with respect.
"We've been waiting for you!"

What heaven lie beyond the gate?
What would he have the idols do? Kou speculated excitedly.

All he wants, whenever he wants. It's the start of happy days... 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE140379.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
男孩不被允许进入传说中的偶像学校。
为了看看它是否存在，天宫浩去了那里，看到一串美女进入了堡垒般的外门。
包括他自己的继妹。

“传闻是真的……”

当寇试图与一些路过的女孩聊天时，她们像对待垃圾一样看着他，警卫把他拉到一边并把他放在一边。
女孩们继续快乐地走着，就像什么都没发生一样。

“哼。”
像一块脏布一样散落一地，寇的眼中闪烁着光芒。

他回家咨询了他的父亲。

第二天，寇又去了同一个地方，只有卫兵
从昨天开始，现在就排成一排，恭敬地鞠躬。
“我们一直在等你！”

门外有什么天堂？
他会让偶像做什么？寇兴奋地猜测道。

他想要的一切，只要他愿意。幸福的日子就这样开始了…… 

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE140379.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
